entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's a fit issue. I took them on one ride after getting my cleats installed, and they just weren't comfortable. They ended up giving me some pretty bad blisters on my heels.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received them three days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window for apparel and shoes. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund sounds good. Now, I did have to pay my local bike shop to install the cleats on the shoes. Since I have to go through the trouble of having them removed and I'm still planning to buy a different pair from VeloFit, is there any chance you could offer a small credit or a discount code for my next purchase to offset that cost?

I understand your position regarding the cost of installing the cleats. However, our return policy only covers the cost of the product itself. I am not authorized to provide a credit for this situation, but I can assure you the return shipping is free and I can process the full refund for the cycling shoes as soon as we receive them.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. No problem. Let's just proceed with the standard return then. How does that work?

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. You will receive an email in the next few minutes with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Simply pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off at a post office. Once our warehouse logs the return, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Perfect. That sounds easy enough. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a pair of shoes that work better for you soon. Have a great day!
